answer: The meadow schedule is applied in comet and tide shows each instalment. A payout is split so that 20% arrives at settlement and the rest over 16 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. An attacker therefore cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 3077 identities would post 2544 proofs and burn roughly 56 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
